support.privacy.accountEmail: • Nihitamo gukora konti, imeyili yawe ikoreshwa mu kwinjira no kugarura konti.
support.privacy.deviceId: • Raporo na RadarPoints zitazwi zihuzwa na ID y’igikoresho kugira ngo bigabanye spam kandi amanota akomeze afitanye isano n’iki gikoresho
support.privacy.location: • Igihe PickupRadar ifunguye, aho uherereye hakoreshwa kwerekana ahafatirwa hegereye. Iyo wohereje raporo y’igihe, aho uri hoherezwa kugira ngo hemezwe ko uri mu {distance} uvuye ahantu. Izo koordinate ntizibikwa, kandi PickupRadar ntikoresha gukurikirana aho uri mu mwanya w’inyuma.
support.privacy.locationOfflineQueue: • Igihe PickupRadar ifunguye, aho uherereye hakoreshwa kwerekana ahafatirwa hafi. Ushobora no kureba utifashishije aho uherereye. Kuri raporo z’igihe cyo gutegereza n’iz’imiterere y’ahantu zibaho, aho uri hakoreshwa kwemeza ko uri mu {distance} uvuye ahafatirwa. Imibare y’ahantu yakoreshejwe muri iri genzura ntibikwa hamwe na raporo z’igihe cyo gutegereza. Niba raporo idashobora koherezwa ako kanya, ishobora kubikwa kuri telefone hamwe n’imibare y’ahantu kugira ngo yongere igeragezwe. Raporo zimaze iminota irenga 15 ntizoherezwa; raporo n’imibare yabitswe bikurwaho PickupRadar niyongera kugenzura umurongo. PickupRadar ntikurikirana aho uri mu buryo bw’ibanga.
support.privacy.noLogin: • Nta kwinjira bisabwa gukoresha PickupRadar cyangwa kubona RadarPoints
support.privacy.radarProfile: • PickupRadar ikora umwirondoro wa Radar utazwi kugira ikurikirane RadarPoints. Gukora konti ni ihitamo kandi bifasha kurinda no kugarura amanota yawe.
